name: MubinFlow
headline: Payroll that shows its working.
promise: HR and payroll for UAE businesses of about 10 to 250 people. In development.

proof.title: Every amount has a reason.
proof.body: The payroll engine traces each figure on a payslip to the rule behind it, and each rule cites its source.

proof.title: No guessing.
proof.body: Where no sourced rule exists yet, the figure is listed as not computed.

proof.title: The salary file, written and checked.
proof.body: It writes the salary information file (SIF) for a pay run, checks any SIF file and explains each problem in plain English.

statusLine: In development. Not yet available. No website yet.
ownerToConfirm: Whether to offer an 'Ask about MubinFlow' call to action, and which email it opens.
